title: Spike: Guardrails
purpose: Surface constraints: security, compliance, scale, and performance requirements.

questions.label: Security Requirements
questions.prompt: What security requirements apply? (e.g., auth model, data at rest/transit, secrets management)

questions.label: Compliance Constraints
questions.prompt: Are there regulatory or compliance constraints? (e.g., GDPR, SOC2, HIPAA, internal policies)

questions.label: Scale and Performance
questions.prompt: What are the scale and performance requirements? (e.g., requests/sec, data volume, latency SLA)
